Definition: baldness in the forehead; by analogy, a bare spot on the right side of cloth
BiblicalUsage: Gabbachath is baldness in the forehead, and it belongs to the laws of leprosy. If a white reddish sore appears in the bald head or bald forehead, the priest must look upon it in Leviticus 13:42 and Leviticus 13:43, and after washing, if the plague has not changed its colour, the garment must be burned in Leviticus 13:55. The word is a piece of the careful law that kept Israel clean.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the careful laws about skin and cloth show how seriously God takes uncleanness. Nothing was too small to examine, and I hold that the same God still looks closely at the hidden places of our lives.
